# kubesense_mongodbatlas_org (Resource)

A MongoDB Atlas organization integration. KubeSense checks the credentials when the integration is created and refuses ones that fail or belong to another account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Organization-level access: an organization API key sees every project.
resource "kubesense_mongodbatlas_org" "prod" {
  org_id      = "5f3e8a1b2c4d6e7f8a9b0c1d"
  public_key  = "abcdefgh"
  private_key = var.atlas_org_private_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) 24-character Atlas organization id. Changing it creates a new integration.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether collection runs. false pauses it and keeps credentials and settings.
- `client_id` (String) Project public key (project-level access).
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Project private key (project-level access). Write-only on the server, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected, and it is not set on import.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) Organization private key (organization-level access). Write-only on the server, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected, and it is not set on import.
- `public_key` (String) Organization public key (organization-level access).
- `resource_types` (Attributes Map) Resource types to collect, keyed by resource type (see Settings → Integrations for the names). When set, Terraform owns collection: types enabled in the UI but not listed here are switched off on the next apply. When omitted, collection is left to the UI. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_types))

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Name shown in the UI: the account name the credentials resolved to.
- `id` (String) Integration id (the API's kuid).
- `status` (String) pending, healthy, error, paused or deleting.

<a id="nestedatt--resource_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_types`

Required:

- `collect` (Boolean) Collect inventory.
- `metric_enabled` (Boolean) Collect metrics.

Optional:

- `metric_extras` (Set of String) Extra metric names beyond the tier.
- `metric_tier` (String) core (the default) or expanded.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id is the integration's kuid, shown in Settings → Integrations. The
# private key is not imported; set it in the configuration.
terraform import kubesense_mongodbatlas_org.prod 1d7c3e9a-4b2f-4a6e-8c5d-9f0b2a7e3c18
```
